**Powered by 443,000+ FOREWARN users and 660+ REALTOR® associations and MLSs throughout the U.S., the new capability enables agents to instantly warn one another about concerning interactions**


BOCA RATON, Fla., Oct. 26, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — FOREWARN, LLC, a red violet company (NASDAQ: RDVT) and a leading provider of data-driven safety solutions, today announced Community Alerts, a new network-powered capability that enables real estate professionals to flag a phone number after a concerning interaction, providing instantly available additional awareness to all other FOREWARN users. With the industry’s largest, fastest-growing real estate safety network already in place, FOREWARN is uniquely positioned to deliver this critical field safety feature at scale.


Real estate professionals routinely meet strangers, often alone, at vacant properties. Identity verification and criminal record checks reveal critical information, but not every potential threat presents such risk flags. Conversations that don’t add up or encounters that feel threatening or uncomfortable can live outside of underlying identity data. Until now, that awareness of potential danger often went no further than the agent who noticed it.


Community Alerts leverages FOREWARN’s expansive network, more than 443,000 real estate professionals connected through over 660 REALTOR® associations and MLSs, to surface warnings and strengthen safety across the industry. A safety signal built on shared experience is only as strong as the network behind it, and FOREWARN’s powerful and growing user base makes this capability possible in a way that smaller or newer solutions cannot match.


With Community Alerts, an agent who has an interaction that elicits concern, whether by phone or in person, can tag the associated phone number to alert the community. When a flagged number contacts another FOREWARN member, the caution alert appears, giving them the benefit of a peer’s real-world experience before they walk through the door.


“FOREWARN was built to give real estate professionals greater confidence before face-to-face interactions, and Community Alerts extends that mission by turning the experience of individual agents into actionable awareness for the broader community,” said James Reilly, red violet’s President. “A shared alert only works if it reaches the people who need it. With hundreds of thousands of agents within the FOREWARN community, a caution alert raised by one agent can help protect another just moments later.”


Because Community Alerts grows more valuable with every participating agent, it is included at no additional cost for all FOREWARN customers, so every member can contribute to and benefit from the network.


[Learn more](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=5kY4QjVDz_LKuUT6I1X74zObr5kzGzqWFhPYn2EOQEYnJz0Z3fgd88FKFSiFDCa2UUzagRyMVoUYL2PxknnzzhVtVHPCTTrz4Nji-AhqAus=) about FOREWARN Community Alerts.
